ANTIFRAUD::alert_bait_signatures
Description
This command returns the bait signatures in an escaped base64 format
for the trojan_bait alert.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_bait_signatures
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert bait signatures: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_bait_signatures]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
